key_insight: Decision2Care performed clinical work-ups without generating text, recording candidate actions, probabilities, and execution rules for audit.
clinical_relevance: Auditable action records could help clinicians review how an AI assessment evolved, though clinical deployment requires further validation.
method: Assigns probabilities to permitted electronic health record actions.
Uses fixed rules to execute the highest-probability action.
Tracks diagnostic options at each step and applies the same decision approach to treatment selection.
evidence_signal: Across 546 emergency admissions covering 12 diseases, diagnostic accuracy was 86.5% versus MIRA-v2’s 86.1%, with a median work-up time of 2.2 seconds versus 92–100 seconds.
watch_item: This records-based evaluation does not establish prospective clinical safety; four errors in the highest-confidence diagnoses were traced to individual imaging reports.
paper_title: Auditable Clinical Support with Decision Agents
